metadata.technology_specification: Automatic capsule filling machine (dosator or tamping pin type)
metadata.technology_reasoning: The automatic capsule filling machine, specifically dosator or tamping pin type, is the industry-standard form used widely in pharmaceutical manufacturing for high-volume capsule filling due to its precision and speed, dominating the market over manual or semi-automatic types as of 2024.

components.reasoning: Essential for orienting and feeding empty capsules into the machine; commonly procured as a distinct module.
Core component responsible for measuring and dispensing powder or granules into capsules; central to machine function and typically manufactured as a dedicated subassembly.
Includes the chute, tamping pins, and powder leveling devices that work collectively to fill capsule bodies accurately; a major subassembly often standardized and replaced separately.
Mechanism that joins the capsule cap and body after filling; a separate, critical functional assembly in the filling process.
Powers all moving parts of the machine; standard industrial motors and gearboxes with a dedicated supply chain.
Includes PLC or microcontroller-based control units, operator interface, and sensors; essential for automation and typically a standalone assembly.
Supports all components providing rigidity and alignment; a separate module often manufactured in sheet metal or stainless steel.
Receives and holds bulk powder before dosing; a distinct component often supplied separately.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Stainless steel
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Used for structural and wear-resistant parts of feeding components, standard industry material for food-grade mechanical parts due to corrosion resistance and strength.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Aluminum
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Lightweight structural parts and housings used for mechanical assemblies to reduce weight while maintaining corrosion resistance; common in feeding mechanisms.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Polyethylene
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Used for low-friction sliding or guiding components due to chemical inertness and smooth surface; alternatives exist but polyethylene is common.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Copper
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Utilized in electrical wiring and sensors in the feeding system; copper is common but other conductive metals could substitute.

Dosator (or Dosing) Mechanism.name: Stainless steel
Dosator (or Dosing) Mechanism.reasoning: Critical for all contact parts with powders for corrosion resistance and hygienic standards; universally used in dosing mechanisms in pharmaceutical equipment.

Dosator (or Dosing) Mechanism.name: Polyethylene
Dosator (or Dosing) Mechanism.reasoning: Used in non-contact parts or bushings for low friction; common but alternatives like PTFE can substitute.

Dosator (or Dosing) Mechanism.name: PTFE
Dosator (or Dosing) Mechanism.reasoning: Applied as coatings for powder contact surfaces to prevent sticking and ensure dosing accuracy; not always mandatory but common.

Filling Station Assembly.name: Stainless steel
Filling Station Assembly.reasoning: Primary raw material for structural, mechanical and product-contact parts due to corrosion resistance and compliance with pharmaceutical standards.

Filling Station Assembly.name: Aluminum
Filling Station Assembly.reasoning: Used in structural and mechanical components to reduce weight; common but less used in direct product contact.

Filling Station Assembly.name: PTFE
Filling Station Assembly.reasoning: Coating or lining material to minimize powder adhesion and improve cleaning; commonly used though alternatives exist.

Capsule Closing Station.name: Stainless steel
Capsule Closing Station.reasoning: Used for durable, hygienic mechanical parts that engage with capsule closure; universally essential for equipment in contact with products.

Capsule Closing Station.name: Aluminum
Capsule Closing Station.reasoning: Used for mechanical parts and housings where weight reduction is beneficial; common but not universal.

Capsule Closing Station.name: Polypropylene
Capsule Closing Station.reasoning: Used for possibly insulation or non-mechanical components; not critical but plausible in component design.

Drive System (Motors and Gearbox).name: Steel Ingots
Drive System (Motors and Gearbox).reasoning: Base raw material for gears and shafts due to required mechanical strength and wear resistance; standard industry practice.

Drive System (Motors and Gearbox).name: Copper
Drive System (Motors and Gearbox).reasoning: Used extensively in motor windings and electrical components for excellent electrical conductivity; essential for motor function.

Drive System (Motors and Gearbox).name: Aluminum
Drive System (Motors and Gearbox).reasoning: Used in motor housings and some gearbox components to reduce weight; common but not critical.

Control Panel and Electronics.name: Copper

Control Panel and Electronics.name: Glass

Control Panel and Electronics.name: Polycarbonate

Frame and Structural Body.name: Stainless steel

Frame and Structural Body.name: Aluminum
Frame and Structural Body.reasoning: Used as lightweight structural alternatives or complementary components to steel frames; common industry practice.

Powder Supply Hopper.name: Stainless steel
Powder Supply Hopper.reasoning: Used for product contact surfaces due to corrosion resistance and ease of cleaning; essential to meet pharmaceutical standards.

Powder Supply Hopper.name: Polyethylene
Powder Supply Hopper.reasoning: Used for non-contact or lining parts to reduce weight or cost; possible substitute but not universal.

Powder Supply Hopper.name: PTFE
